ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE.example: Request installation by a trusted pack publisher.
ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE.message: The exact approved action implementation is unavailable on the endpoint.
ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Ask the operator to install an approved compatible action pack; do not supply executable code in YAML.

ACTION_INPUT_INVALID.remediation: Call describe_action and change only the indicated with field to match input_schema, including required fields, exact types and enum values.

ACTION_KEY_COLLISION.message: Multiple installed implementations claim the same action and version.
ACTION_KEY_COLLISION.remediation: Publisher must correct the registry; do not select an implementation from the agent.

ACTION_NOT_VISIBLE.example: Use list_actions with the authenticated session.
ACTION_NOT_VISIBLE.message: The requested action is not available to this caller.
ACTION_NOT_VISIBLE.remediation: Do not retry with another identity; request authorized access through the owning service.

ACTION_OUTPUT_INVALID.example: Check declared output_schema and correlated execution ID.
ACTION_OUTPUT_INVALID.message: Action {action} returned output that does not match its declared output_schema.
ACTION_OUTPUT_INVALID.remediation: Do not invent an output field; report the action implementation defect to its publisher.

ACTION_PACK_UNTRUSTED.example: Contact action pack owner with correlation_id.
ACTION_PACK_UNTRUSTED.message: The action pack signature or publisher trust verification failed.
ACTION_PACK_UNTRUSTED.remediation: Stop; have the trusted operator verify installation and signing configuration.

ACTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.example: Call describe_action and compile a new plan.
ACTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.message: The action schema or implementation digest differs from the compiled plan.
ACTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.remediation: Stop this plan, refresh catalog and revalidate/reapprove before any resubmission.

ACTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED.example: Call list_actions for the exact target.
ACTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED.message: Action {action} is not supported on the selected target.
ACTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Select a target-compatible action from list_actions or stop.

ACTION_UNKNOWN.message: Action {action} is not installed or visible for this target.
ACTION_UNKNOWN.remediation: Call list_actions for this target and replace uses with an exact returned key; do not invent an implementation.

ACTION_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE.message: Action {action} has no compatible installed version for requested major {version}.
ACTION_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Inspect list_actions/describe_action and use a currently advertised compatible major.

APPROVAL_INVALID.example: Preview and request approval for the compiled plan.
APPROVAL_INVALID.message: The supplied approval is invalid, expired, or bound to another plan or target.
APPROVAL_INVALID.remediation: Request a new approval for the exact current plan; do not alter parameters under an old approval.

APPROVAL_REQUIRED.example: Wait for trusted approval provider status.
APPROVAL_REQUIRED.message: This plan requires external approval before any restricted action can run.
APPROVAL_REQUIRED.remediation: Report pending approval and use the approved workflow; do not fabricate approval tokens.

APPROVAL_REVOKED.example: Contact approving authority if action remains needed.
APPROVAL_REVOKED.message: Authorization for this plan was revoked.
APPROVAL_REVOKED.remediation: Stop; do not resubmit automatically or try another target.

ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.message: The artifact digest does not match the signed plan.
ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.remediation: Reject artifact and notify the operator; never fall back to unsigned bytes.

ARTIFACT_EXPIRED.example: Request result from the authorized execution.
ARTIFACT_EXPIRED.message: The referenced artifact is expired or no longer accessible.
ARTIFACT_EXPIRED.remediation: Re-run only an authorized safe producer or request a fresh scoped handle.

ARTIFACT_NOT_APPROVED.message: The requested artifact is not approved for this operation.
ARTIFACT_NOT_APPROVED.remediation: Request trusted publisher onboarding; do not provide an arbitrary download address or executable blob.

ARTIFACT_SCOPE_DENIED.example: Obtain a scoped result through get_execution_results.
ARTIFACT_SCOPE_DENIED.message: The artifact is not authorized for this workflow or principal.
ARTIFACT_SCOPE_DENIED.remediation: Use an authorized artifact reference; do not copy or fabricate handles.

CATALOG_STALE.example: Refresh catalog for the selected target.
CATALOG_STALE.message: The action catalog changed since discovery.
CATALOG_STALE.remediation: Call list_actions and describe_action again; regenerate and validate the workflow.

CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.example: Call list_actions again after service is healthy.
CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.message: The current trusted action catalog could not be obtained.
CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Retry discovery after service recovery; do not guess action inputs or execute with cached stale schemas.

CONDITION_INVALID.message: The condition at {path} is invalid or has incompatible operands.
CONDITION_INVALID.remediation: Use only documented typed comparison operators and published producer fields.

CONDITION_SOURCE_SKIPPED.example: Guard consumer with the producer success condition.
CONDITION_SOURCE_SKIPPED.message: A required condition/input depends on a step that may be skipped.
CONDITION_SOURCE_SKIPPED.remediation: Add an explicit guard or optional fallback consistent with the workflow schema.

DAG_CYCLE.message: Workflow dependencies contain a cycle involving {step}.
DAG_CYCLE.remediation: Remove the cyclic dependency or reference so every step depends only on prior producers.

DAG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.example: Split independent investigations into separate authorized workflows.
DAG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: Workflow graph exceeds allowed step/dependency/concurrency limits.
DAG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.remediation: Reduce step count, depth or parallelism within published limits.

ERROR_CODE_UNKNOWN.remediation: Use the stable code returned by the MCP error envelope; inspect documented error codes.

EVAL_CONFIGURATION_MISSING.message: A required local evaluation setting is missing.
EVAL_CONFIGURATION_MISSING.remediation: Provide runtime environment variables and both explicit live-test opt-ins; never commit values.

EVAL_MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.message: The configured model endpoint cannot complete the required evaluator protocol.
EVAL_MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.remediation: Verify an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions implementation and structured tool-calling support.

EVAL_TURN_LIMIT.example: Compare failed scenario against fixture oracle.
EVAL_TURN_LIMIT.message: The model evaluation exceeded its bounded turn or correction limit.
EVAL_TURN_LIMIT.remediation: Inspect sanitized transcript and reduce ambiguity or improve the skill; do not lift safety limits implicitly.

INTERNAL_ERROR.example: Provide correlation_id in a support report.
INTERNAL_ERROR.message: An unexpected internal error occurred; execution details are withheld.
INTERNAL_ERROR.remediation: Report correlation_id to the service operator; avoid repeated submissions of mutating workflows.

MCP_RESULT_LIMIT.example: get_execution_results with page_size within published limit.
MCP_RESULT_LIMIT.message: The MCP result exceeds the permitted response size.
MCP_RESULT_LIMIT.remediation: Use bounded pagination or authorized result handles.

MCP_SESSION_UNAUTHENTICATED.message: The MCP session does not have an authenticated principal.
MCP_SESSION_UNAUTHENTICATED.remediation: Use the host-supported authentication flow; do not supply principal data inside workflow YAML.

MCP_TOOL_ARGUMENT_INVALID.message: MCP tool {tool} received invalid arguments at {path}.
MCP_TOOL_ARGUMENT_INVALID.remediation: Read this MCP tool input_schema and resubmit only declared required fields with correct types.

MCP_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.message: The selected MCP operation is not available.
MCP_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: List advertised MCP tools/resources and use only supported operations.

MODEL_TOOL_CALLING_UNSUPPORTED.message: The model response did not contain a valid structured tool call.
MODEL_TOOL_CALLING_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Configure a server/model with JSON tool-call support; text pretending to call tools is insufficient.

OUTPUT_REDACTED.message: Some output fields were redacted under result access policy.
OUTPUT_REDACTED.remediation: Report only available authorized evidence; do not infer missing values or seek alternate outputs.

OUTPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED.message: The action output could not be serialized within its declared contract.
OUTPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED.remediation: Report implementation defect to action publisher; do not invent replacement data.

PLAN_EXPIRED.message: The execution plan is outside its approved validity window.
PLAN_EXPIRED.remediation: Create a new validated/authorized plan rather than replaying the expired plan.

PLAN_REPLAY_CONFLICT.message: Execution ID or nonce has already been used with a conflicting plan.
PLAN_REPLAY_CONFLICT.remediation: Stop; inspect existing execution status and report the replay conflict.

PLAN_SIGNATURE_INVALID.remediation: Stop execution and contact the endpoint administrator; never regenerate a signature in agent YAML.

POLICY_STALE.example: Refresh policy and preview a new plan.
POLICY_STALE.message: The endpoint policy revision does not authorize this plan.
POLICY_STALE.remediation: Stop and compile/reapprove against current policy after operator review.

POLICY_UNAVAILABLE.example: Retry preview after policy service recovery.
POLICY_UNAVAILABLE.message: The policy evaluation service is unavailable; execution is denied.
POLICY_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Wait for policy service recovery; do not bypass authorization or simulate approval.

RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.message: The effect of action {action} is uncertain after interruption.
RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.remediation: Stop automated retries; use its registered reconciler or obtain operator confirmation.

REFERENCE_SCOPE_DENIED.message: The referenced value is outside this workflow or authorization scope.
REFERENCE_SCOPE_DENIED.remediation: Use only outputs from permitted steps in the current workflow; do not fabricate handles.

REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.message: Output reference {reference} does not exist or cannot be used here.
REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Check producer step ID, its output_schema, dependency order and conditional skip rules.

RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.example: Use a lower max_records or fewer steps if supported by registered schema.
RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.remediation: Reduce workflow scale or request an operator policy change; do not override limits in YAML.

SECURITY_DENIED.example: Request access through approved operational process.
SECURITY_DENIED.remediation: Stop and explain that access or effect is not authorized; do not search for an alternate command path.

SKILL_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.message: The agent skill resource for this API version cannot be retrieved.
SKILL_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Fetch a supported versioned skill resource; stop if the service lacks instructions.

STEP_CANCELLED.message: Execution was cancelled; some in-progress actions may require reconciliation.
STEP_CANCELLED.remediation: Check final step statuses; do not assume a mutation was rolled back.

STEP_EXECUTION_FAILED.message: The registered action failed without a permitted detailed public reason.
STEP_EXECUTION_FAILED.remediation: Inspect safe status, correlate with publisher logs, and retry only if declared safe.

STEP_TIMEOUT.message: Action {action} exceeded its authorized execution deadline.
STEP_TIMEOUT.remediation: Inspect status and side-effect uncertainty before deciding to retry; never blindly repeat mutation.

TARGET_MISMATCH.example: Choose the target returned by the trusted inventory.
TARGET_MISMATCH.message: Signed plan target does not match receiving endpoint identity.
TARGET_MISMATCH.remediation: Stop and obtain a newly authorized plan for the correct endpoint.

TRUST_STORE_MISMATCH.message: The signing identity is not trusted by this endpoint.
TRUST_STORE_MISMATCH.remediation: Stop; operator must repair trusted signing configuration.

TYPE_MISMATCH.message: The value at {path} is incompatible with required type {expected}.
TYPE_MISMATCH.remediation: Use the target action input_schema and producer output_schema to select a compatible value/reference.

WORKFLOW_SCHEMA_INVALID.message: The workflow YAML does not match remote.intent/v1 at {path}.
WORKFLOW_SCHEMA_INVALID.remediation: Use the documented workflow grammar; correct the field at the reported path and validate again.

WORKFLOW_TARGET_INVALID.message: The workflow target is missing or not a valid authorized target.
WORKFLOW_TARGET_INVALID.remediation: Select a target supplied by the trusted hosting service; do not guess device identifiers.

WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT_INVALID.message: The workflow timeout at {path} is outside configured limits.
WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT_INVALID.remediation: Choose a timeout within the published limit for this target and action set.

WORKFLOW_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.message: The workflow API version {version} is unsupported.
WORKFLOW_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Read current service capabilities and use a supported apiVersion.

YAML_PARSE_FAILED.message: The YAML could not be parsed at {path}.
YAML_PARSE_FAILED.remediation: Fix YAML indentation and scalar syntax; submit a single mapping document.

YAML_RESOURCE_LIMIT.example: Use fewer steps in one workflow.
YAML_RESOURCE_LIMIT.message: The YAML document exceeds a parsing limit at {path}.
YAML_RESOURCE_LIMIT.remediation: Reduce document size, nesting, or collection length within published limits.

YAML_UNSAFE_CONSTRUCT.message: The workflow includes a prohibited YAML construct at {path}.
YAML_UNSAFE_CONSTRUCT.remediation: Remove custom tags, aliases, anchors, merge keys or duplicate keys; use ordinary YAML values.
